title: Work permit (c)(9)
intro: The (c)(9) work permit is based on your pending I-485. We do not estimate when it will arrive: we show the rules and the official data.
validity.title: Validity
validity.rule5y: Cards issued before {cut} are valid for up to 5 years.
validity.rule18m: Cards issued from {cut} are valid for up to 18 months.
validity.yours5y: Your permit was issued in {issued}: valid for up to 5 years.
validity.yours18m: Your permit was issued in {issued}: valid for up to 18 months.
validity.yoursUnknown: With the date we have, we cannot tell which rule applies.
validity.expiryCard: Your card expires {date} (the date you entered).
validity.readCard: Read the date on your card: the date you enter is the one that counts.
renewal.title: Renewal
renewal.rule: Renewals filed on or after {from} get no automatic extension (final rule of {rule}); an employer cannot rely on the receipt alone.
renewal.planner: We suggest filing the renewal at least {days} days before expiry, that is, from {date}.
renewal.filed: You said you filed the renewal on {date}.
renewal.filedAuto: You filed it before {from}, so you may have the earlier automatic extension; check your receipt notice.
renewal.filedNoAuto: No automatic extension: your permit ends on the card date even if the renewal is still pending.
renewal.markExample: Changes are not saved in the example case.
reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.enabled: Reminders are on for this phone.
reminders.denied: We do not have permission to send notifications; you can allow it in the phone's settings.
reminders.web: Reminders only work in the phone app.
pending.title: If your permit is pending
pending.inquiry: National Benefits Center (NBC), I-765 (c)(9): inquiry date {date} (published {pub}).
pending.allNationalities: All nationalities: there is no separate figure for Cubans.
pending.earlier: Earlier, for context: {quarter} (quarterly report), {pending} pending. The figure above replaces it.
pending.press: Reported waits: {lo} to {hi} months (press, {month}; not an official figure).
pending.noModel: We do not compute an estimate for the work permit.
c11.title: Parole-based permit (c)(11)
c11.body: Parole-based work permits (c)(11) were revoked in {chnv} (CHNV) and in {cbp} (CBP One). The (c)(9) from your pending I-485 is a different permit and remains valid if you have it.
noCase: Set up your case to see your permit's validity and your reminders.
